content.title: Update release expertise: NPM publishing is deferred
content.description:
Project-level decision (owner-directed, 2026-06-17): the agentrack library will NOT be published to NPM at this stage. There is no need to publish the library yet, and there are no NPM credentials available.

Action required — update your release expertise (`.agentic/expertise/library-releaser/**`) to reflect:

1. **Release tasks complete at the pre-publish stage.** A release is considered DONE once: tests pass, docs updated, build verified, and version bumped (and committed/tagged if applicable). Do NOT block on NPM publishing, do NOT report missing NPM credentials as a blocker, and do NOT leave release issues in-progress waiting for npm auth.
2. **NPM publish is an explicitly deferred phase**, not a missing prerequisite. If a release issue's only remaining step is NPM publish, mark it done with a comment noting publish was skipped per this decision.
3. **The publish mechanism will be revisited** when the project decides how releases should be managed (current release-overview / release-recipe expertise that gates on NPM_TOKEN / `release.yml` should be amended so the publish step is optional/deferred, not required).

Reference: the in-progress release task `mqe27481sa` ("Release: library token override") was closed as done on this basis. Future release issues should follow the same convention until further notice.

Deliverable: comment on this issue summarizing the expertise updates made, then mark done.

content.content: Closing as a duplicate. This task was superseded by mqi9fpjvx6 (same goal: update release expertise so release completes at version-bump/build/commit and does not block on npm auth). The newer set (mqi9fp1wf6 architect + mqi9fpjvx6 releaser + mqi9g0bia7 validator) is the single source of truth — it has proper validation gating and blockages, which this orphan lacked. No progress was recorded here. Reassigning the releaser to mqi9fpjvx6.
